questions.question: He is one of (a)/ those who would much rather (b)/ sacrifice his life than turn disloyal to the country. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use ‘their’ in place of ‘his’ Explanation:- Yahan yeh ‘who’ wala Adjectival Clause ‘those’ ko refer karne ke liye likha gya hai joki Plural hai. Yaani cheeze plural ke hisaab se chalegi, isliye Possessive Adjective 'His' nahi 'their' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Each of the researchers who were assigned to the international climate project were asked to submit his findings by the end of the quarter.
options: who were assigned to the international climate project
his findings by the end of the quarter
questions.solution: replace ‘were’ with ‘was’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘were asked’ verb ka subject ‘each’ hai. ‘each’ ek distributive pronoun hota hai joki singular verb leta hai, isliye yahan ‘were asked’ ki jagah ‘was asked’ aayega. Note:- Sentence mein ‘who were assigned…...project’ wala clause researchers ke liye aaya hai, isliye whan plural verb 'were assigned' sahi hai.

questions.question: The Taj Mahal (a)/ is one of (b)/ the most beautiful (c)/ creation in the world.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘creations’ in place of ‘creation’ Explanation:- Yahan "of" Preposition selection ko dikhaane ke liye use ki gayi hai isliye iske baad aane wala Noun Plural mein prayog kiya jayega isliye 'Creation' nahi 'Creations' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I am indebted to my friends for the large sum of money what they gave me during my days of need.
questions.solution: replace ‘what’ with ‘that’ Explanation:-Sentence mein ‘what they…….days of need’ yeh ek noun clause hai aur ‘money’ noun hai, lekin noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjectival clause ki jarurat hai jiske liye ‘what’ ki jagah par ‘that’ relative pronoun sahi hoga jo ‘money’ noun ke liye ‘adjectival clause’ banayega. ‘what’ relative pronoun se ‘noun clause’ banta hai aur ‘that’ relative pronoun se ‘adjectival clause’ banta hai.

questions.question: It goes without saying (a)/ that your house which (b)/ is in Delhi is far better (c)/ than my one in various ways.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘mine’ in place of ‘my one’ Explanation:- ‘Your house’ ka comparison 'my house' se hona hai jiske liye Possessive pronoun "mine" ka use hoga. Kyunki ‘I’ ka possessive case ‘Mine’ hota hai naa ki 'My one'.

questions.question: He is among those rare individuals who not only dedicates himself but also inspire others to excel.
options: but also inspire others to excel
questions.solution: replace ‘dedicates himself’ with ‘dedicate themselves’ Explanation:-Sentence mein ‘dedicates’ verb aur ‘himself’ reflexive pronoun ka subject ‘individuals’ plural hai jiske according plural verb aur plural reflexive pronoun ayega, isliye ‘dedicates himself’ ki jagah par ‘dedicate themselves’ sahi hoga. sentence mein ‘who not only…..other to excel’ yeh clause ‘rare individuals’ ke liye likha hai, isliye subject ke according verb aur reflexive pronoun ayega.

questions.question: I am not sure (a)/ if the red car (b)/ in the parking slot (c)/ is your. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘yours’ in place of ‘your’ Explanation:- Possessive Adjective kabhi akele use nahi hote yahan "your car" wala meaning dena hai isliye Possessive Pronoun "yours" ka prayog hoga.

questions.question: He has never disobeyed (a)/his master that is (b)/ a mark of a great disciple. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: replace ‘that’ with ‘which’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘he has never disobeyed his master’ ke aage wale poore clause ko refer karna hai aur poore clause ko refer karne ke liye ‘which’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai, isliye yahan ‘that’ ki jagah ‘which’ relative pronoun sahi hoga. sentence ka matlab hai ‘wo apne master ki har baat maanta hai, yeh poori baat ‘ek great disciple ki nishaani hai’, isliye yahan poore clause ko refer karna hai.

questions.question: Each cigarette which (a)/ a person smokes does (b)/ some harm and eventually you (c)/ may get a serious disease from its effects. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘he’ in place of ‘you’ Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according serious bimari uss vyakti ko hogi jo cigarette smoke karta hai naa ki is sentence ko sunn ne wale ko, 'you' pronoun listener ko represent kar raha hai, hume us vyakti ko refer karna hai jo cigarette smoke karta hai isliye yahan 'you' nahi 'he' ka prayog hoga.

questions.question: It’s wise to be conscious of time and it’s ripple effect on money.
questions.solution: replace ‘it’s ripple’ with ‘its ripple’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘ripple effect’ ek noun hai aur noun se pehle adjective ki jarurat hoti hai, ‘it’s’ ek ‘pronoun+ verb’ ka structure aur ‘its’ possessive adjective hai, isliye ‘ripple effect’ noun se pehle ‘its’ possessive adjective sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: Any of the two (a)/ pictures which depict (b)/ the real pictures of the present (c)/ politicians is worth seeing. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘either’ in place of ‘any’ Explanation:- ‘Any’ ka use hum tab karte hain jab hume do se zyada mein se koi bhi ek wala meaning dena hota hai aur ‘either’ ka use hum tab karte hain jab hume do mein se koi bhi ek wala meaning dena hota hai. yahan do cheezo ki baat ho rahi hai isliye yahan 'any' ka nahi 'either' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Children can injure himself (a)/in the blink of an eye so the parents (b)/should always be cautious. (c) /No error.(d)
questions.solution: replace ‘himself’ with ‘themselves’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘himself’ reflexive pronoun ‘children’ ke liye likha hai, kyunki ‘children’ ek plural noun hai jiske liye yahan plural reflexive pronoun ayega, isliye yahan ‘himself’ ki jagah ‘themselves’ reflexive pronoun sahi hoga. Reflexive pronoun ka use tab hota hai jab sentence mein doer aur receiver same ho.

questions.question: You say(a)/ it's your problem(b)/ but I say it's(c)/ my also.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘mine’ in place of ‘my’ Explanation:- Possessive adjective akele use nahi kiye jaate, yahan 'my problem' wala meaning dena hai. Isliye yahan Possessive pronoun 'mine' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The 63rd edition of the Grammys was historic for Beyonce, which is now the female artist with the most trophies.
options: The 63rd edition of the Grammys was
questions.solution: replace ‘which’ with ‘who’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘beyonce’ noun hai jiske liye ‘which’ relative pronoun lagake clause likha hai, lekin human being ke liye ‘who’, ‘whom’ relative pronoun ka use hota, isliye yahan ‘which’ ki jagah par ‘who’ relative pronoun sahi hoga. jab agle clause mein subject ki jarurat ho toh ‘who’, aur object ki jarurat ho toh ‘whom’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai.

questions.question: I had to hold on (a)/to the wall (b)/to steady itself (c)/or I could have fallen. (d)
questions.solution: Use ‘myself’ in place of ‘itself’ Explanation:- Yahan sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki mujhe deewar ko pakadna pada khud ko sthir karne ke liye. Toh 'I' ke anusar yahan Reflexive pronoun 'Itself' nahi balki 'myself' ka prayog hoga.

questions.question: Neither of the two candidates who were interviewed extensively by the board have submitted his verification documents.
options: who were interviewed extensively by the board
questions.solution: replace ‘have’ with ‘has’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘have submitted’ verb ka subject ‘neither’ hai, kyunki ‘each, either, neither’ distributive pronoun hote aur apne sath singular verb lete hai, isliye yahan ‘have submitted’ ki jagah par ‘has submitted’ sahi hoga. sentence mein ‘who were……by the board’ yeh clause ‘two candidates’ ke liye likha hai.

questions.question: You may be an editor or a reporter, (a)/ this makes you sit,(b)/ that makes you run.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Replace ‘an editor or a reporter’ with ‘a reporter or an editor’ Explanation:- Jab 2 nouns ke baare mein extra information dene ke liye ‘this’ and ‘that’ lagake new clauses likhte hain toh ‘this’ uss noun ko refer karta hai jo this ke pass hai aur ‘that’ door wale ko. Yahan ‘this’ apne nearest noun ‘reporter’ ko refer kar rha hai. Aur ‘that’ ‘editor’ ko refer kar raha hai lekin uss se Meaning galat ho rha hai kyunki editor office mein baith ke kaam karta hai aur reporter field me bhaag ke. isliye yahan par editor aur reporter ko interchange karna padega taki meaning sahi ho jaaye.

questions.question: Now its referring to the same big lug who met his fate thanks to David's slingshot.
options: big lug who met his fate
Now its referring to the same
questions.solution: replace ‘its’ with ‘it’s’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘its’ possessive adjective ke baad noun ki jarurat hai, lekin ‘referring’ pehle se hee adjective(present participle) hai, toh yahan ‘referring’ se pehle (subject or verb) ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan ‘its’ adjective nahi, ‘it’s’ (pronoun + H.V.) sahi hoga, isliye ‘it’s referring’ sabse sahi hoga. sentence mein doubt hoga ki ‘who’ relative pronoun ki jagah par ‘that’ aana chaiye kyunki ‘the same, the few, the little, superlative degree etc.) ke sath ‘that’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai, lekin sentence mein agar (subject, verb) ki error hai, toh baaki errors ko humesha weak error samajh kar ignore kar denge.

questions.question: Neither of the two medical students (a)/ suspected in the 'Missing girl' case (b)/ have so far been arrested.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use ‘has’ in place of ‘have’ Explanation:-‘Neither’ ek distributive pronoun hota hai aur iske sath singular verb aati hai, isliye yahan par 'have' nahi 'has' ka use hoga. Note: ‘Suspected’ yahan koi verb ki tarah se kaam nahin kar raha hai yeh ‘Past Participle’ hai jo ki Adjective ki tarah kaam kar rha hai.

questions.question: She is the professor (a)/ whom research students often admire her (b)/ because all her publications have been internationally recognized. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘whom’ with ‘whose’ Explanation:- Yahan par galti yeh hai ki ‘whom’ object banane ka kaam krega aur clause ke last me ‘her’ likha hai joki object hai. Ab iss sentence ko sahi krne ke do tareeke hai ya to hum ‘whom’ ki jagah par ‘whose’ likh de uss se bhi sentence theek ho jayega aur uska matlab ye niklega ki ‘unke research students admire krte hai unhe’ aur dusra tareeka ye ho sakta hai ki hum ‘her’ ko hata de lekin isko hatane ke baad ‘research students’ se pahle ‘the’ bhi lagana hoga kyunki particular students ki bat ho rhi jo uss teacher ke hai. Toh iss sentence ko theek krne ke do tareeke hue ek to ‘whom’ ki jagah par ‘whose’ krke aur dusra her ko hatakar research students se pahle ‘the’ article ka use krna. Dono se meaning alag alag aayega lekin grammatically dono options allowed hai.

questions.question: With food granaries overflowing, (a)/the Government is looking (b)/to liquidate his grain stock (c)/to prevent damage. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘its’ in place of ‘his’ Explanation:- Yahan hume ‘Government’ Subject ke according Possessive adjective lagana hai. Isliye yahan 'His' nahi 'Its' ka use hoga.

questions.question: A man who has been accused of fraud in an earlier job, he will never be  welcomed in any other organisation.
options: A man who has been accused of fraud
in an earlier job, he will never be
questions.solution: remove ‘he’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘man’ noun hai jisko verb ki jarurat hai aur iski verb ‘he’ pronoun ke sath likhi hai joki galat hai. subject ki verb ‘will never be welcomed’ hogi aur ‘he’ yahan superfluous hai, isliye yahan ‘he’ nahi ayega. sentence mein ‘who has been…..earlier job’ ek adjectival clause hai jo noun ka description de raha hai.

questions.question: The people in (a)/my office are (b)/smarter than other offices.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use ‘those in other offices’ in place of ‘other offices’ Explanation:- Mere office ke People ka comparison dusre office ke people se hoga naaki ‘office’ se isliye 'those in other offices' likhna padega.

questions.question: He is (a)/the same man (b)/which I saw with your sister (c)/yesterday at the gate.(d)
questions.solution: replace ‘which’ with ‘that’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘which’ ki jagah par ‘that’ ayega kyunki ‘the same/the few/the little/the only/ superlative degree’ jab kisi noun ke sath lage ho toh uske sath ‘that’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai, isliye yahan ‘which’ ki jagah par ‘that’ sahi hoga.

questions.question: My older brother, (a)/ which you’ll (b)/ meet later, (c)/ is a dentist.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘whom’ in place of ‘which’ Explanation:- Yahan hume ‘Brother’ noun ko Refer karne ke liye ek Relative Pronoun likhna hai aur Human being ke liye ‘who/whom’ ka prayog kiya jata hai. ‘Who’ subjective case hota hai aur ‘Whom’ objective case hota hota hai. Which animals aur things ke liye use kiya jata hai yahan hume ‘meet’ verb ka object banana hai, isliye 'whom' ka prayog hoga.

questions.question: She rarely approached nobody to talk about the problems that she was facing.
questions.solution: replace ‘nobody’ with ‘anybody’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘rarely’ ke sath ‘nobody’ ka use nahi hoga, kyunki ‘rarely, barely, seldom’ yeh negative adverb hote hai aur inke sath ‘nobody’ ka use double negative ho jayega, isliye yahan ‘nobody’ ki jagah par ‘anybody’ sahi hoga, jisse matlab hoga ‘usne naa ke barabar hee approach kiya kabhi kisi ko’.

questions.question: A current account is a deposit account (a)/ which is offered by banks mainly (b)/ to firms and companies who (c)/ need banking facilities very frequently.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘which’ in place of ‘who’ Explanation:- Yahan hume ‘firms and companies’ ko refer karne ke liye ek Relative Pronoun likhna hai, kyunki yeh dono non-living hai. Isliye yahan par 'who' nahi 'which' ka prayog hoga.

questions.question: The matter, which you and him have been discussing for days, needs to be escalated to the management for the final decision.
options: The matter, which you and him
needs to be escalated to the management
questions.solution: replace ‘him’ with ‘he’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘which’ waale clause mein ‘you and him’ subject hai, agar yeh subject hai toh ‘him’ ki jagah par ‘he’ subjective case ayega, kyunki ‘him’ toh objective case hota hai, isliye yahan ‘him’ ki jagah par ‘he’ sahi hoga. Additionally sentence mein ‘you’ sahi hoga kyunki iska subjective, objective case same hota hai, ‘have been discussing’ verb hai, or ‘which’ relative pronoun jo object banega iss clause mein.

questions.question: We ordered a Pizza (a)/ which are one of (b)/ my favourite foods.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use ‘is’ in place of ‘are’ Explanation:- Yahan 'which' Relative Pronoun ‘pizza’ ke liye likha gya hai. Relative Pronoun ka apna khudka koi number aur Gender nahi hota yeh 'which' yahan Pizza ke liye aaya hai jo ki singular ki tarah use ho raha hai. Isliye 'which' ke baad Singular Verb ka prayog hoga, 'are' nahi 'is' aayega.

questions.question: He can become a scientist or a teacher, (a)/ this requires long hours in a lab, (b)/ and that requires most of the day in a classroom. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘a scientist or a teacher’ with ‘a teacher or a scientist’ Explanation:- Sentence mein jab doo noun diye hote hai aur unhe ‘this’ aur ‘that’ se define karte hai, toh ‘this’ apne nearest noun ke liye aata hai, sentence mein pehle ‘teacher’ aur phir ‘scientist’ sahi hoga, kyunki ‘this’ waali baat ka description ‘a scientist’ ke liye likha hai, aur generally pehle ‘this’ likhte hai uske baad ‘that’, aur ‘this, that’ ko change karne se doo part mein error ho jayegi, isliye yahan ‘a teacher or a scientist’ noun ko change kar denge.

questions.question: This is the woman (a)/ whom all sons are married (b)/ and well (c)/ settled in their lives.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘whose’ in place of ‘whom’ Explanation:- Iss sentence ka matlab yeh hai ki yeh wo aurat hai jiske saare bete Married hain aur well settled hain, toh yahan hume woman ke ‘sons’ par Possesion banana hai toh yahan ek esa word chahiye jo Possession ko dikhata ho isliye 'whose' ka use hoga 'whom' keval ek objective case hota hai. Yahan Objective Case ki requirement nahi hai, kyunki ‘All sons’ Subject ho chuka hai, ‘are’ linking verb hai aur 'married' aur 'well settled' adjective hai jo subject complement ki tarah se kaam kar rahe hain. Isliye yahan hume Objective Case ki jarurat nahi hai. Balki ek esa word chahiye jo ‘woman’ ka 'All sons' par Possession dikhaye isliye yahan 'whom' nahi 'whose' ka use hoga.

questions.question: After a long and fun-filled day, the children slept themselves peacefully.
questions.solution: remove ‘themselves’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘themselves’ reflexive pronoun nahi ayega kyunki ‘sleep’ ek intransitive verb hoti hai jisse object ki jarurat nahi hoti, isliye object ‘themselves’ galat hoga, isliye yahan ‘children slept peacefully’ sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: Now it has finally dawned (a)/ upon her that one (b)/ should never compromise (c)/ with his dignity, integrity and self respect.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘one’s’ in place of ‘his’ Explanation:- Iss Clause ka subject 'one' hai. Isliye possession bhi 'one' ke according hi banega, Isliye 'his' nahi 'one's' possessive adjective ka use hoga.

questions.question: The woman, whom I assumed / was a guest lecturer / turned out to be the dean / of the University.
options: turned out to be the dean
questions.solution: replace ‘whom’ with ‘who’ or replace ‘was’ with ‘to be’ Explanation:- yahan ‘assume’ verb se 3 structure mind mein aa sakte hai ki ‘whom I assumed a guest lecturer’, toh iss structure mein aise banane ka soch sakte ho ki ‘I’ subject ‘assumed’ verb, ‘whom’ indirect object aur ‘lecturer’ direct object, lekin bolne sunne mein accha lagega, lekin ‘assume’ verb iss structure mein di- transitively use nahi hoti, isliye yeh structure galat hoga. 2nd structure yeh ki - agar human being indirect object banake likhna hai toh ‘to be’ ke sath likhna padega, toh ‘whom I assumed to be a great lecturer’ jisme ‘whom’ indirect object aur ‘to be’ direct object aur ‘a guest lecturer’ object of infinitive banega, tab yeh structure sahi hoga. 3rd structure mein ‘whom’ ki jagah’ ‘who’ kar denge kyunki ‘was’ verb ke pass subject nahi hai, verb bina object ke chal sakti hai, lekin bina subject ke nahi, isliye yahan subjective case ‘who I assumed was a great lecturer’ wala structure bhi sahi hoga. toh 2nd structure ‘was’ ki jagah ‘to be’ yaa 3rd structure ‘whom’ ki jagah ‘who’ dono sahi honge.

questions.question: There are a number of new (a)/ arrivals in this shoe store (b)/ but only those shoes (c)/ which are old one are available at a discounted price.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘that’ in place of ‘which’ and replace ‘one’ with ‘ones’ or we can also remove ‘one’ Explanation:- Yahan do galtiyan hai. One ki jagah Ones ka use hoga kyunki hume Shoes ko refer karne ke liye Plural Pronoun chahiye yaa hum ‘one’ ko hata bhi sakte hain kyunki linking verb ke baad akela adjective aa sakta hai aur yahan reference clear hai ki shoes ki hi baat ho rahi hai toh dobara pronoun likhne ki jarurat nhi hai.2nd error hai:- ‘which’ ki jagah ‘that’ use hoga kyunki yeh Relative Pronoun shoes ko refer kar rha hai. Jisse pehle ‘only those’ laga hua hai. Jo iss par emphasis daal raha hai. Isliye yahan 'which' nahi 'that' relative Pronoun use hoga.

questions.question: I remember a friend of me buying several pairs of shoes from this shop.
questions.solution: replace ‘a friend of me’ with ‘a friend of mine’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘of me’ ki jagah par ‘of mine’ ayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai mere doston mein se ek, jiske liye ‘a friend of mine’ likhte hai, jisme ‘of’ preposition yahan selection ko dikhaati hai aur ‘mine’ possessive pronoun hota hai. isliye yahan ‘a friend of mine’ sahi hoga. Jab bahut saare mein se ek ke baare mein batana ho toh ‘a friend of mine’, aur jab ek hee dost ke baare mein batana ho toh ‘the friend of me’ jiske liye ‘my friend’ bhi likh sakte hai.

questions.question: You and your friend (a)/ are here, but who (b)/ of you is to work with me(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘which’ in place of ‘who’ Explanation:- Yahan iss clause ka matlab yeh hai ki tum mein se mere sath kaun kaam karega, iss Clause ke meaning se aur sath hi ‘Of’ Preposition jo Selection ko dikhati hai usko lage hone se clear ho raha hai ki hume yahan Selection karwana hai. Aur Selection case me humesha 'Which' relative pronoun ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Do you know their are numerous street food stalls outside our school premises?
questions.solution: replace ‘their’ with ‘there’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘their’ possessive adjective hai jiska baad noun ki jarurat hoti hai, sentence mein noun bhi nahi hai aur yahan matlab dena hai ‘wahan’ waala, jiske liye yahan ‘their’ adjective nahi, introductory subject wala ‘there’ sahi hoga. Additionally sentence mein jab bhi ‘ki’ wala sense dena hota hai toh ‘that’ conjunction understood hoti hai kyunki sentence mein do verb hai ‘know’ aur ‘are’, jinke clauses jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hoti.

questions.question: The articles (a)/ published in this magazine (b)/ are better than (c)/ that magazine. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘'those published in that magazine' in place of ‘that magazine’ Explanation:- Ek magazine ke Articles ka Comparison dusre magazine ke Articles se hi hoga isliye yahan ‘those’ ka use hoga sath hi Published Adjective jo first clause mein de rakha hai. Usse bhi hume meaning ko same rakhne ke liye, repeat karna padega. Isliye 'those published in that magazine' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Each customer who enters the store (a) / is greeted by the staff, offered assistance (b) / and often asked to fill out your details in a feedback form. (c) /no error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘your details’ with ‘his or her details’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘each customers’ ki baat ho rahi details bharne ke liye, toh har customer apni details bharega naa ki tumhari, isliye yahan ‘your’ possessive adjective ki jagah par ‘his or her’ possessive adjective aayega. Customer male yaa female koi bhi ho sakta hai isliye yahan ‘his or her’ sahi hoga.

questions.question: After a long gap, (a)/ we went shopping (b)/ last Sunday and bought (c)/ that we wanted.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘what’ in place of ‘that’ Explanation:- Yahan hume ‘bought’ verb ka object banane ke liye noun clause ki requirement hai naa ki koi Adjectival Clause ki isliye hum yahan par ‘that’ nahi ‘what’ relative pronoun ka use karenge jo noun clause banane ke liye use kiya jata hai. Note:- we went shopping me koi galti nahi hai yahan 'went' ke baad 'for' preposition understood ho jaati hai yeh structure Allowed hai.

questions.question: The engineers working at our headquarters in San Francisco (a)/ have contributed significantly more to the product design and innovation process (b)/ than the office in our Tokyo branch (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘than the office’ with ‘than those at the office’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘san Francisco ke engineers’ ka comparison ‘Tokyo branch ke engineers’ se hoga, isliye yahan engineers ka comparison karne ke liye ‘than’ ke baad ‘those at’ aayega, kyunki comparison humesha same cheezon mein hota hai, ‘those’ kyunki Tokyo branch mein engineers plural honge, aur ‘at’ isliye kyunki ‘san francisco’ mein ‘working at’ likha hai, isliye yahan bhi ‘at’ preposition sahi hogi, toh ‘than those at the office’ sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He was not aware of (a)/ the things and the people (b)/ who had surrounded him (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘that’ in place of ‘who’ Explanation:- Yahan hume aisa Relative Pronoun chahiye jo cheezon aur insaano dono ko ek sath refer kar sakta ho isliye yahan 'that' relative Pronoun ka use hoga.

questions.question: We believed (a) / there would be beneficial (b) / to expand the business internationally (c) / after analyzing the market trends carefully. (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘there’ with ‘it’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘would’ H.V. hai, ‘be’ main verb hai, ‘beneficial’ adjective hai, ‘to expand’ real subject hai jo ki infinitive hai, agar sentence mein ek infinitive subject hai, toh infinitive ko subject bnane ki wajaaye hum starting mein ‘it’ introductory subject ka use kar lete hai, jaise ‘to dance is easy’ ko likhte hai ‘it is easy to dance’. Isliye yahan ‘there’ ki jagah ‘it’ introductory subject sahi hoga.

questions.question: Her mother promised to (a)/ give her anything what she (b)/ wanted if she (c)/ passed the examination.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘that’ in place of ‘what’ Explanation:- Yahan anything pronoun ko define karne ke liye ek Adjectival Clause ki zarurat hai naa ki Noun clause ki isliye yahan 'what' nahi 'that' relative pronoun ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: The director asked whether it was me who had taken the final call on approving the budget.
options: who had taken the final call
questions.solution: replace ‘me’ with ‘I’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘who had taken….. the budget’ yeh baat ‘me’ ke liye likhi gayi hai, toh sentence mein ‘it’ introductory subject ka use real subject ‘me’ pe stress daalne ke liye kiya hai, agar aapko subject pe stress daalne hai toh ‘me’ ko subjective case ‘I’ mein likhna padega, isliye ‘it was I’ sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: Those who are late (a)/they will not be allowed (b)/inside the classroom. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: remove ‘they’ Explanation:- Yahan 'will not be allowed' wala jo part hai. Yeh verb those pronoun ke liye aayi honi chahiye thi, yadi hum ‘they’ laga denge toh ‘those’ pronoun ko verb nahi milegi isliye ‘they’ pronoun yahan superfluous hai isse remove karna padega.

questions.question: He, you and I (a)/ need to prepare the final report (b)/ before the meeting scheduled next Monday morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘He, you and I’ with ‘you, He and I’ Explanation:- Sentence mein order of pronoun ka sequence galat hai, general sequence ‘2-3-1’ hota hai aur negative mein ‘1-2-3’ sequence hota hai. sentence mein koi negative baat nahi hui isliye general sequence 2-3-1 follow hoga, isliye ‘you, He and I’ sabse sahi sequence hoga.

questions.question: He has never hurt my sentiments (a)/ that is a mark of a great (b)/ and altruistic lover. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘which’ in place of ‘that’ Explanation:- Yahan relative pronoun ka antecedent poora clause ban raha hai aur poore Clause ko refer karne ke liye 'which' Relative Pronoun ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: They who are in this room (a)/ should not move from the place (b)/ where they are standing, said the (c)/ leader of the criminals. (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘they’ with ‘those’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘they’ ki jagah par ‘those’ ayega. jab bhi relative pronoun se pehle ‘they’ likhna ho toh usse demonstrative pronoun mein likhte hai, kyunki demonstrative se meaning aur clear ho jata hai, isliye yahan ‘they’ ki jagah ‘those’ demonstrative pronoun sahi hoga.

questions.question: Whom do you (a)/ think she is, if she knows (b)/ so many things (c)/ about you?(d)
questions.solution: use ‘who’ in place of ‘whom’ Explanation:- Yahan 'who' and 'whom' ‘she is’ waale clause ke according bhara jaana hai, linking verb ke baad kabhi objective case nahi aate, humesha subjective case hi aate hain isliye 'whom' nahi 'who' ka prayog kiya jayega.

questions.question: She asked me (a)/ why did the marketing team decide(b)/ to change the entire campaign strategy (c)/ without consulting the sales department first. (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘did the marketing team decide’ with ‘the marketing team decided’ Explanation:-Yeh sentence indirect speech mein likha hai aur indirect speech mein ‘did’ ka use nahi hota, aur iski past form dikhaane ke liye ‘verb’ ko past mein likhte hai jo ki subject ke baad ayegi, toh ‘decide’ verb ki past form ‘decided’ hogi, isliye yahan ‘the marketing team decided’ sabse sahi answer hoga. subject se pehle verb interrogative sentence mein aati hai

questions.question: You can buy that (a)/ you want if (b)/ you top this exam. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘what/whatever’ in place of ‘that’ Explanation:- Yahan ‘buy’ verb ko object ki zarurat hai. Aur object yahan ‘you want’ poora clause ban raha hai, aur ‘what’ se noun clause bante hai Isliye yahan 'that' ka nahi ‘what/whatever’ ka use hoga ‘what’ se matlab hoga jo tumhe chahiye aur ‘whatever’ se matlab hoga jo bhi tumhe chahiye. Dono hi use kiye jaa sakte hain.

questions.question: The team leader (a)/ complained about (b) / us leaving the meeting early(c) / No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘us leaving’ with ‘our leaving’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘complained about’ phrasal verb ka object ‘leaving’ hai aur object se pehle adjective ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye ‘us’ pronoun ki jagah ‘our’ possessive adjective sahi hoga. sentence mein ‘the meeting’ object of gerund hoga kyunki gerund semi-verb hote hai, jisko object ki jarurat hoti hai.

questions.question: He is (a)/the same man (b)/which I saw (c)/yesterday at the gate.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘that’ in place of ‘which’ Explanation:- Yahan ‘the same’ se, man par emphasis daala jaa raha hai. Isliye yahan relative pronoun 'which' nahi 'that' ka use hoga. Note:- Yahan ‘Whom’ ka use nhi kar sakte kyunki yahan ‘the same’ se ‘man’ par emphasis dala hua hai, isiliye yahan ‘that’ hi sahi mana jayega.

questions.question: The teacher, along with two senior students who volunteered during the event,  were given an award for  his commitment and leadership.
options: The teacher, along with two senior students
questions.solution: replace ‘were given’ with ‘was given’ Explanation:-Sentence mein ‘were given’ verb ka subject ‘teacher’ hai kyunki ‘teacher’ singular noun hai isliye singular verb ‘was given’ sahi hoga. sentence mein ‘along with’ prepositional phrase hai jiske object ‘two senior students’ hai aur ‘who volunteered……event’ tak yeh ‘senior students’ ke liye likha hai.

questions.question: The five brothers (a)/ are at daggers-drawn, (b)/ so they feel it below their dignity (c)/ to talk to each other.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘one another’ in place of ‘each other’ Explanation:- Yahan five brothers ke liye Reciprocal pronoun lagana hai isliye reciprocal pronoun 'one another' ka use hoga naa ki 'each other' ka. 'each other' ka use do people yaa things ke liye, 'one another' more than two people or things.

questions.question: Banks that do not meet its priority sector targets are required to pay high penalties.
questions.solution: replace ‘its priority’ with ‘their priority’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘that do……sector targets’ yeh clause ‘banks’ ke liye likha hai kyunki ‘banks’ plural hai isliye adjective bhi plural ayega, isliye ‘its’ ki jagah par ‘their’ sahi hoga.

questions.question: We thought (a)/ there was a good idea (b)/ to wear snow boots (c)/ before we stepped out.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘it’ in place of ‘there’ Explanation:- 'It' and 'there' dono hi introductory Subject ka kaam kar lete hain. But dono alag alag jagah use kiye jaate hain. Yahan hume 'to wear' infinitive ko refer karna hai, aur infinitive ko refer karne ke liye 'It' ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'It' sahi hoga.

questions.question: My colleagues and myself have decided to conduct a thorough review of the policies that were implemented last year by the former management.
options: have decided to conduct a thorough review
of the policies that were implemented last year
questions.solution: replace ‘myself’ with ‘I’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘myself’ reflexive pronoun hai jo object banta hai, jab kisi action ka doer aur receiver same hota hai uske liye aata hai, lekin sentence mein ‘have decided’ verb hai jiske liye subject ki jarurat hai, isliye ‘myself’ ki jagah ‘I’ subject aayega.

questions.question: I find that (a)/ I get myself tired (b)/ very easily (c)/ these days.(d)
questions.solution: remove ‘myself’ Explanation:- Yahan 'get' linking verb ki tarah se work kar rahi hai, 'I' subject hai aur 'tired' subject complement ki tarah se work kar raha hai. Yahan koi Action nahi ho raha hai naa hi kisi object ki zarurat hai isliye yahan Reflexive pronoun 'myself' ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: Let they decide whether or not  they wish to continue working  under the current team leader.
questions.solution: replace ‘they’ with ‘them’ Explanation:-Sentence mein ‘let’ verb hai aur ‘they’ verb ka object hai, ‘decide’ bare infinitive hai aur ‘let’ verb ka understood subject ‘you’ hai, toh sentence mein ‘let’ verb ke object ke jarurat hai, isliye ‘they’ ka objective case ‘them’ likhna padega. Isliye ‘they’ ki jagah ‘them’ sahi hoga. ‘bare infinitive’ wala concept advance verb ka topic hai.

questions.question: There is many ways (a)/ to make (b)/ a stranger feel (c)/ welcome in the community.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘are’ in place of ‘is’ Explanation:- Jab 'there' word introductory subject ki tarah work karta hai toh verb real subject ke according aati hai. Yahan real subject 'ways' hai isliye verb plural aayegi, isliye 'is' nahi 'are' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The team leads, all of who had extensive experience managing remote teams, were tasked with training the new recruits.
options: The team leads, all of who
had extensive experience managing remote teams
questions.solution: replace ‘all of who’ with ‘all of whom’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘of’ preposition hai jiske baad object ki jarurat hoti hai, lekin ‘who’ subjective case hota hai, isliye yahan subjective case ki jagah par objective case ‘whom’ sahi hoga. ‘whom’ preposition ka object bhi ban raha hai aur conjunction ka bhi kaam kar raha hai. sentence mein ‘had’ verb ka subject ‘all’ hai.

questions.question: Me and my friends (a)/ often go (b)/ to the cinema (c)/ together.(d)
questions.solution: Use ‘My friends and I’ in place of ‘Me and my friends’ Explanation:- Yahan do changes karna hai, ek toh yeh General sentence hai isliye Pronoun ka sequence '231' use karna tha, aur dusra hume yahan subjective case ki zarurat hai isliye 'me' nahi 'I' aana tha isliye yahan par ‘my friends and I’ ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: Don’t worry I will (a)/ provide anything what you (b)/ need for your higher studies. (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: replace ‘anything what’ with ‘anything that’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘what’ ki jagah par ‘that’ aayega kyunki ‘what’ ka use noun clause banane ke liye hota hai, lekin sentence mein ‘will provide’ verb ke pass ‘anything’ object hai, isliye yahan ‘what’ se noun clause ki nahi ‘that’ se adjectival clause ki jarurat hai aur ‘all, none, both, everything, anything, the few, the little etc.’ ke sath ‘that’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai, isliye bhi ‘that’ relative pronoun sahi hoga.

questions.question: Payal as well as her friends was (a)/ absented themselves (b)/ from the class because (c)/ it was the day of 'Bihar-band'.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘absent’ in place of ‘absented’ and remove ‘themselves’ Explanation:- Absent do kaam karta hai verb banna ya adjective banna jab yeh verb banta hai toh apne sath Reflexive Pronoun rakhta hai but iss sentence ka structure thoda complex hai yahan (a) part mein was diya gaya hai aur (b) part mein absented likha gaya hai agar hum isse passive maane toh bhi passive ke andar object nahi hota hai isliye ‘themselves’ drop hoga lekin yahan passive kaa koi sense nahi hai isliye passive manna bhi sahi nahi hoga. (a) part se ‘was’ ko hata ke bhi theek nahi ho payega kyunki subject ‘Payal’ hai uske according reflexive pronoun ‘herself’ aana chahiye tha, aur 2 parts mein toh error mark kar nahi sakte isliye sabse best option yahan par yeh kiya jaa sakta hai ki absented ko kaat kar absent likh de jisse voh adjective ban jayega aur adjective ke sath reflexive pronoun nahi aata hai toh themselves ko drop kar diya jayega. Yaani sahi sentence hoga Payal as well as her friends was absent from the class. Note:- as well as yahan koi simile nahi hai yeh ek Prepositional phrase hai isliye verb Payal ke according aayegi joki was likhi gayi hai jo ki sahi hai.

questions.question: The applicant, whom the committee believed to have the required credentials and experience, was asked to resubmit  their documents with additional proof.
options: The applicant, whom the committee believed
to have the required credentials and experience
questions.solution: replace ‘their documents’ with ‘his/her documents’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘was asked’ verb ka subject ‘applicant’ hai joki singular subject hai, toh singular subject apne hee documents submit karega naa ki kisi aur ke, isliye yahan ‘their’ plural adjective ki jagah par ‘his/her’ singular adjective sahi hoga.

questions.question: The principal objected (a)/ to them wearing short skirts (b)/ at the function. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘their’ in place of ‘them’ Explanation:- 'object to' yeh ek Phrasal verb ki tarah se work karta hai aur sentence ke meaning ke according principal ka jo objection hai veh wearing se hai, naa ki them se isliye object to phrasal verb ka object ‘wearing’ banega jo ki ek noun Gerund ke roop me work karega isliye yahan isse pehle 'them' pronoun ka nahi 'their' possessive adjective ka use hoga.

questions.question: Agricultural experts warn that those are precisely the challenges — unpredictable climate patterns, declining soil fertility, and water scarcity that threaten global food security.
options: that threaten global food security Sentence Improvement
questions.solution: replace ‘those’ with ‘these’ Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘those’ ki jagah ‘these’ ayega kyunki jab kisi cheez ka reference saamne/pass hota hai, toh uske liye ‘these’ pronoun ka use karte hai.

questions.question: Rashmi and me are (a)/ planning to go on (b)/ a road trip to Manali (c)/ next summer.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘I’ in place of ‘me’ Explanation:- Yahan hume Verb ke subject ki zarurat hai isliye 'me' nahi 'I' ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: Can you guess that of this vessels can hold the least amount of water?
options: which of this vessels can hold
which of these vessels can hold
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein meaning chaiye ‘inn mein se konsa vessel’, yeh meaning ‘that’ se nhi diya jaa sakta, isliye option B galat hoga. option A bhi galat hoga kyunki ‘vessels’ plural ke sath ‘this’ ka use galat hai. option C bhi galat hoga kyunki isme selection nahi ho raha hai. structure same aur meaning sahi rakhne ke liye option D sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Neither he (a)/ nor his brother (b)/ can walk faster (c)/ than me.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘than I’ in place of ‘than me’ Explanation:- Subject ka comparison Subject se hota hai. Isliye yahan than ke baad objective case 'me' nahi 'I' subjective case ka use hoga, jiske baad 'can' modal understood hai, usse likhna chahe toh likh bhi sakte hain 'than me' nahi 'than I' (Can) ka use hoga.

questions.question: This is one of the boldest economic reform which have ever been introduced.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘one of’ likha hai jo selection ko dikhata hai isliye ‘one of’ ke baad plural noun aata hai. sentence mein ‘the boldest’ superlative degree adjective hai, toh ‘all, none, but, the few, the little, superlative degree’ ke sath ‘that’ relative pronoun ka use hota hai. Relative pronoun ka khudka koi number gender nahi hota isliye wo apne antecedent ke according verb leta hai toh ‘reforms’ plural hai isliye yahan plural verb ‘have’ sahi hogi, isliye diye gaye options mein se ‘economic reforms that have ever’ option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It will (a)/ be us who will (b)/ buy a new house (c)/ No error.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘we’ in place of ‘us’ Explanation:- Yahan 'it' introductory subject hai. Hume real subject 'we' par stress daalna tha isliye yahan Subjective case 'we' ka use hoga naa ki objective case 'us' ka.

questions.question: Many employees struggle to adopt to the changing work environment in the digital age.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option B aur D nahi honge kyunki ‘adopt’ ka matlab ‘gode lena, koi tareeka apnana’. Option C bhi nahi hoga ‘adapt’ ke sath ‘to’ preposition aati hai. Sentence ka matlab hai ‘bahut employees struggle karte hai khudko dhaalne mein’, isliye yahan ‘adapt’ sahi hoga aur ‘adapt’ aise verb hai jo apne sath reflexive pronoun leti hai, isliye ‘to adapt themselves’ option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Who was (a)/ there but she to look (b)/ after the family in distress? (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘her’ in place of ‘she’ Explanation:- Yahan 'but' ka matlab 'ke sivay yaa ke alawa' hai. Yaani ‘but’ yahan par preposition ki tarah work kar raha hai. Isliye uske baad Objective case ka use hoga. Isliye 'she' nahi 'her' ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: I asked the two students if anyone of them had completed the assignment.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘asked two students’ se pata chal raha ki usne do logo se pucha hai aur do logo ke liye diye gaye option mein se ‘neither of them’ sahi hoga. Baaki ‘anyone, all, none, no one’ yeh more than two ke liye aate hai, isliye option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He prostrated before (a)/ his master (b)/ who had returned from (c)/ London after a year.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘himself’ after ‘prostrated’ Explanation:- ‘Prostate’ verb ek transitive verb hoti hai jise object chahiye aur yahan meaning dena hai, usne khud ko jhukaya, jab kisi action ka doer aur receiver same hota hai, toh reflexive pronoun ka use karte hai isliye ‘himself’ reflexive pronoun sahi hoga.

questions.question: After spending an hour at the beach, we finally got out and dried us.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai ‘ek ghanta beech pe bitaane ke baad, finally bahar nikle aur khudko sukhaya’, toh sentence mein ‘dry’ karne waale action ka doer aur receiver same hai, sukhaane aur sookhne waale wo khud hai, isliye yahan reflexive pronoun ‘ourselves’ ka use hoga, isliye ‘got out and dried ourselves’ option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He, you and I are to be blamed (a)/ for all the mess in (b)/ the last evening's program. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: use ‘I, you and he’ in place of ‘He, you and I’ Explanation:- Yahan blamed verb se pata chal raha hai ki koi galat kaam ko represent karna isliye yahan Pronoun ka sequence 1-2-3 chalega.

questions.question: When one devotes all ______ time and energy to a particular goal, success becomes almost inevitable.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein subject ‘one’ hai toh subject ke according ‘one’s’ possessive adjective sahi hoga, isliye ‘one’s’ option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: We must do (a)/ regular exercises (b)/ to keep (c)/ ourselves fit. (d)
questions.solution: remove ‘ourselves’ Explanation:- Jab action khud par hi hota hai toh 'keep' linking verb ki tarah se work karti hai iss sentence ka matlab hai ki, hume Regular exercise karni chahiye fit rehne ke liye, isliye yahan par Reflexive pronoun ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: People like she and Rohan should be encouraged to participate in the debate competition.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘like’ ek preposition hai aur preposition ke baad object aate hai, toh pronoun ‘she’ ka objective case ‘her’ aayega aur ‘Rohan’ noun ka subjective, objective case same hoga. isliye ‘like her and rohan’ option B sabse sahi answer hoga. ‘like, unlike, including, excluding, except, between, among’ yeh sab prepositions hoti hai.

questions.question: Lalitha will go (a)/ to sister’s house (b)/ in Mumbai (c)/ this summer. (d)
questions.solution: use ‘her’ before ‘sister’s’ Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according 'sister's' se pehle 'her' possessive adjective ka use karna padega.

questions.question: He spent all which he has in order to perfect his invention.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘all’ se pata chal raha ki ‘that’ relative pronoun ayega kyunki ‘all, none, both, everything, anything, the few, the little, superlative degree’ ke sath ‘that’ relative pronoun aata hai . toh option C mein ‘that’ bhi aa raha hai aur ‘had’ se past ka meaning bhi theek hai, isliye ‘that he had’ option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The man standing (a)/ beside the minister is (b)/ a friend of me. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Use ‘a friend of mine’ in place of a friend of me’ Explanation:- A friend of mine: Iss structure ka meaning hota hai ki mere doston me se koi ek. Yahan 'of' preposition selection ka work karta hai. The friend of me: Iss structure ka meaning hota hai mera koi ek particular dost. Yahan 'of' preposition possession ka work karta hai. Hum keh sakte hain ‘the friend of me = my friend’ Note:- ‘a friend of me’ sahi term nhi hai uski jagah yahan ‘a friend of mine’ ya ‘the friend of me’ ka use karein. Waise to iss sentence mein inn dono me se koi bhi use kar sakte hain but ‘a friend of mine’ se thoda better meaning ayega.

questions.question: Whomever is responsible for this financial loss to the company must be held accountable.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘who’ aur ‘whoever’ dono subjective hote hai aur ‘whom’ aur ‘whomever’ dono objective hote hai. sentence mein ‘is’ verb ke liye subject ki jarurat hai, isliye subjective case ayega, isliye ‘whoever’ option A sabse sahi answer hoga. ‘whoever’ ka matlab ‘jo koi bhi’.

questions.question: No one of them (a)/came to the (b)/inauguration of (c)/our new Factory.(d)
questions.solution: Use ‘none’ in place of ‘no one’ Explanation:-'No one' aur 'none' mein kuch difference hota hai jaise ki, (a) 'none' insaano aur cheezo dono ke liye aa sakta hai. 'no one' generally sirf insaano ke liye use kiya jaata hai. (b) 'none' ko kisi 'Group me se koi nahi' kehne liye use kar sakte hai, but 'no one' 'group me se koi nahi' wala meaning dene ke liye use nahin hota hai. Yahan group me se koi nahi wala meaning dena hai, isliye 'no one' nahi 'none' ka use hoga.

questions.question: It is yourself who will decide your future.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Reflexive pronoun ka use tab karte hai jab kisi action ka doer aur receiver same ho, lekin sentence mein aisa koi action nhi ho raha aur sentence mein ‘is’ linking verb hai jo stress daalne ka kaam kar rahi hai. aage, sentence mein ‘who’ relative pronoun likha hai toh isse pehle subjective case likhna padega, isliye diye gaye options mein se ‘you’ option A sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: I don’t recognise none of (a)/ the politicians who have been(b)/ invited to be (c)/ the speakers today. (d)
questions.solution: Use ‘any’ in place of none’ Explanation:- Yahan recognize se pehle jo 'not' hai uski wajah se yeh clause pehle hi negative ho chuka hai. None lagane se dubara negative ho jayega isliye yahan par 'none' nahi 'any' ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: During the interview, she asked me  how many languages do I speak fluently.
options: how many languages did I speak
how many languages does I speak
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein kahi gayi baat indirect speech mein likhi hai, isliye yeh sentence assertive sentence hai aur assertive sentence mein ‘do, does, did’ helping verb nahi ayegi, isliye diye gaye options mein se ‘how many languages I speak’ option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In order for he (a)/ to attend the meeting, (b)/ he needs to prepare (c)/ exhaustive notes. (d)
questions.solution: Use ‘him’ in place of ‘he’ Explanation:- 'he' ki jagah 'him' ayega kyunki ‘for’ ek prepostion hai aur preposition ke baad iska object aata hai isliye 'he' ke objective case 'him' ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: This book is more interesting than either of  the three novels I read last month.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ‘either’ ki jagah ‘any’ aayega kyunki ‘either’ ka use do cheezon ke liye hota hai, lekin sentence mein ‘three novels’ ki baat hui hai, do cheezon se jyada ke liye ‘any’ ka use hota hai, isliye ‘more interesting than any of’ option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Mr. Sunil Pawar, our representative (a)/ he will (b)/ attend the meeting (c)/on our behalf. (d)
questions.solution: remove ‘he’ Explanation:- Yahan Mr. Sunil Pawar subject ki tarah se work kar raha hai, our representative case in apposition hai jo subject ko define kar raha hai aage aane wali verb subject 'Sunil Pawar' ko milni chahiye thi. Isliye yahan likha gaya 'he' pronoun superfluous hai use hata denge.

questions.question: When Riya saw Ankit holding a jacket just like her’s, she thought he had borrowed it without asking.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai ‘riya ne dekha ki ankit ki jacket uski jacket ki tarah hai’, naa ki riya ki tarah, toh yahan par jacket pe possession banana hai, isliye yahan ‘hers’ possessive pronoun ayega jiska matlab ‘uski jacket’ hoga, isliye option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: They who didn’t (a)/ attend the last seminar (b)/ would not be allowed in the next seminar (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use ‘those’ in place of ‘they’ Explanation:- Relative Pronoun se pehle 'they' ka demonstrative Version likha jaata hai isliye yahan 'they' nahi 'those' ka use kiya jayega, yeh baat aapko yaad hi karni hai. Bas dhyan rakhiyega Introductory Subject 'It' wale jo sentence hote hai. For example :- It is they who took you to hospital. Yahan par 'They' hi rahega isme 'Those' nahi karna hai.

questions.question: The two rival companies have finally decided to cooperate with one another to overcome the financial crisis caused by the recent market slump.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Jab bhi do logon ki baat ho toh ‘each other’ aur do se jyada(more than two) toh ‘one another’, sentence mein ‘two rivals’ ki baat hui hai, isliye yahan ‘each other’ option A sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: The woman is waiting to see you looks rather angry.
options: The women whose waiting to see you looks rather angry
The women who is waiting see you looks rather angry
The woman who is waiting to see you looks rather angry
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan do verb di gayi hai. Jisse pata chal raha hai ki do clauses banne chahiye aur sentence ka meaning bhi kuch esa hai. Jo aurat bahar tumhe milne ka wait kar rhi hai, gusse me dikhayi pad rahi hai. Isliye yahan par 'who' relative pronoun ka use hoga aur wait ke baad direct verb nahi likh sakte isliye infinitive 'to see' ka use hoga, isliye (c) option best hai.

questions.question: The employees blamed no one but ______ for the failure of the project, acknowledging that they had ignored critical warnings.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai ‘employees ne blame kiya aur kisi ko nahi balki khudko’, toh ‘blame’ verb ke action ke doer aur receiver employees hai, isliye yahan reflexive pronoun aayega, kyunki ‘employees’ plural hai, isliye yahan plural reflexive pronoun ‘themselves’ sabse sahi hoga.   

questions.question: Thomas is a man of word (a)/ who have been paying back (b)/ the borrowed money (c)/ in instalments.(d)
questions.solution: use ‘has’ in place of ‘have’ Explanation:- Yahan 'who' relative pronoun ‘Thomas’ ke liye likha gaya hai, kyunki 'Thomas' singular hai isliye 'who' ke baad singular verb ka use kiya jaayega, isliye 'have' nahi 'has' aayega.

questions.question: Civil servants (a)/should exert to help (b)/ a common man. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'themselves' after 'exert' Explanation: -'exert' verb transitive hoti hai aur apne sath reflexive pronoun leti hai jab subject khud pe action perform kar raha ho, isliye yahan ‘exert’ ke baad 'themselves' reflexive pronoun ayega. Exert ka matlab ‘normal se jyada effort karna’

questions.question: She is the woman (a)/ who I know, (b)/ you can trust blindly. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'who' with 'whom'. Explanation:- Yahan relative pronoun 'trust' verb ke liye lagana hai. Jise object chahiye. Kyunki ‘whom’ objective case hota hai, isliye yahan ‘whom’ ka use sahi hoga. Note:- Relative pronoun who/whom ka yahan 'know' verb se koi relation nahi hai.

questions.question: The company decided to sell their stake in their subsidiary because it was under massive debts.
options: sell their stake in its subsidiary
sell its stake in their subsidiary
sell its stake in its subsidiary
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan subject 'company' jo ki singular hai isliye possessive adjective singular subject ke according use honge. Isliye ‘its stake and its subsidiary’ wala option (d) sahi hoga.

questions.question: He was not able to adopt himself to the new environment of the hostel.
questions.solution: Explanation:- isko samjne ke liye 3 points samajhne honge 1. ‘able’ adjective ke baad generally infinitive (to + vb) aata hai. Eg. ‘He was not able to repay the loan.’ 2. ‘adapt’ verb ka reflexive pronoun + to + object ka structure use hota hai . Eg. He adapted himself to the new city. 3. adept - skillful adopt - lgana ya baccha god lena adapt - dhaalna yahan ‘dhaalne’ wala meaning dena hai. inn teeno points ke according Answer (d) sahi hoga.

questions.question: None of the girl deserve to be selected for this award.
options: None of the girls are deserving
questions.solution: Explanation:- None + of + noun (plural) + verb (singular) ye structure apko class me padhaya gaya hai. iske according Answer d sahi hoga.

questions.question: He brought these sweets for you and I.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘for’ preposition ke baad preposition ke object aayenge isliye objective case use hoga :- 'for you and me' option (c) sahi hoga.

questions.question: In the introductory session, the teacher asked me to what district I came from.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘what’ ka meaning hota hai – ‘kya’ and ‘which’ ka meaning hota hai – konsa, yahan meaning ye dena hai ki teacher ne pucha tha mai konse district se hu. isliye ‘which’ ka use hoga. aur ‘from’ preposition jiske meaning 'se' hota hai wo last mein di hai isliye 'to' preposition nhi lagegi.

questions.question: I asked two people the way to Diana's house but no one of them knew it.
options: whether either of them knew it
if none of them knew it
that no one of them knew it
but neither of them knew it
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence me 2 logon ki baat ho rahi hai or 2 ke liye neither use hota hai naki ‘none yaa no one’ ka, isliye option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Abraham also had one sister, of who not much has been recorded.
questions.solution: Explanation:-'of' preposition hai aur preposition ke baad object aate hai, isliye iske baad objective case 'whom' ayega. yahan meaning dena tha jiske baare mein jada kuch recorded nahi hai. 'of + whom' se possession wala meaning banega 'of + whom'= jiske

questions.question: Neither of the leading political parties have had much success in the southern region.
options: Neither of the leading political parties has had much
Neither of the leading political party has had much
Neither of the leading political parties have had any
questions.solution: Explanation:- neither + of + noun(plural) + verb (singular) iss structure ke according sirf option B sahi hai.

questions.question: Please clean your room first and than meet I downstairs.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai please pehle apne room clean karo uske baad mujhe neche aake milo, toh ‘uske baad’ wala meaning ‘and then’ se ayega aur ‘meet’ verb ke baad object chahiye, isliye objective case ‘me’ ayega’. Isliye option D sahi hoga. ‘than’ comparison ke liye use hota hai.

questions.question: Both of mine child passed the examination successfully.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 2 bachon ki baat ho rahi hai isliye ‘child’ ka plural ‘children’ use hoga. ‘Children’ noun se pehle ‘my’ possessive adjective lagega naki ‘mine’ pronoun. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: I can neither punish him nor reward him for which he have done.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan 'for' preposition ka object aage ka pura noun clause banega. Aur noun clause banane ke liye ‘what’ relative pronoun ka use karte hai correct structure:- 'for what he has done' Note:- ‘he’ ke baad ‘has’ aayega aur has ke baad V3 aayegi iss basis par bhi sirf c option hi shi hai

questions.question: They each listened carefully to what each other said.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan verb ‘listened’ hai naa ki ‘talked’ isse clear hai ki ek time mein ek hi person bola hoga baaki sab sun rahe honge. isliye ‘each other’ ka use nhi hoga kyunki apas mein baat nahi ho rahi hai. ek ne jo bola wo dusre ne dhyan se suna iss meaning ke liye 'what the other said' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Often it makes one wonder at the sights you see,
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan ‘wonder’ verb ka subject ‘one’ hai toh obviously sights ko dekhne wala bhi ‘one’ he hoga. aur ‘one’ ke baad verb singular aati hai. Isliye ‘one sees’ option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: Whom was the person that you wanted me to contact there?
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan subjective case ki jarurat hai isliye ‘whom’ ki jagah ‘who’ ayega. Note:- Tense same rakhne ke liye option nhi hai isliye B hi mark karna padega.

questions.question: It is I who am responsible for the success of the organisation.
questions.solution: No improvement required Explanation:- ‘It’ yahan introductory subject hai isliye aage aaya real subject 'I' subjective case mein hi aayega aur ‘who’ 'I' ko refer karne ke liye lgaya gaya hai isliye ‘who’ ke baad verb 'I' ke according 'am' aayi hai.

questions.question: Is this the same book like our teacher recommended?
questions.solution: Explanation:- iss sentence mein pronoun and conjunction dono chapter ke concept ka use hoga. ‘the same’ ke baad 'that' yaa 'as' use hota hai. 'as' relative pronoun ki tarah kaam kar sakta hai. jaise iss sentence me 'as' conjunction + pronoun (object of verb - recommend) ka kaam kar raha hai. Conjunction chapter mein 'such as' pair ki grammar padhke apko 'as' ka relative pronoun banne ka concept clear ho jayega. Note:- similar book se meaning change ho rha isliye wo option nhi lagayenge.

questions.question: Please don't create panic among people during that difficult times.
questions.solution: Explanation:-'difficult times' mein ‘times’ noun plural hai isliye adjective ‘this’ and ‘that’ use nahi honge. present ki baat ho rahi hai isliye meaning ke according ‘these’ ka use hoga. these difficult times - inn mushkil halaton mein those difficult times - unn muskil halaton mein

questions.question: It is important to be aware of what we eat as food choices play an important role and affect their lifespan.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence me 'eat' verb ka subject 'we' hai toh obviously meaning ke according lifespan bhi 'we' ka hi affect hoga isliye 'affect our lifespan' ka use hoga.

questions.question: It's not our book; it must be theres.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Meaning yeh dena hai ki yeh humhari book nahi hai toh jarur yeh unki book hogi or grammar ke according bhi yahan possessive pronoun ki requirement hai. "It must be theirs" sahi hoga Note:- theres and their's jaise words exist hi nahi karte grammar mein.

questions.question: Most of us hesitate to accept our mistakes.
questions.solution: No substitution required Explanation:- yahan 'Most of Us ' ka meaning hai hum logon mein se jyadatar. ‘Much’ uncountable ke liye aata hai , ‘more’ comparison ke liye aata hai aur ‘lots many’ jaisa koi adjective nahi hota isliye b, c ,d options nahi ho sakte.

questions.question: A hole is in my pocket.
questions.solution: Explanation:- kisi cheez ki position ko introduce karne ke liye generally 'there' introductory subject ka use kiya jata hai. Isliye option D sahi hoga. Ex. There is a cat under the table. There is a dog inside the car. etc.

questions.question: Try to avail of every opportunity that comes your way.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘Avail’ verb ka structure hota hai :- avail + reflexive pronoun + of + noun (wo cheez jo avail karni ho). Yahan 'try to avail' se pata chal raha hai ki advice di jaa rahi hai or yeh imperative sentence hai jiska understood subject 'you' hota hai isliye 'avail yourself of ' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Doctors at the AllMS Trauma Centre managed to save the life of 12 year old archer Shivangini, whose were struck by an arrow in the neck during a practice session.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'jise struck kiya gaya tha ek arrow ke dwara' isliye 'who was struck' ka use hoga. Note:- Shivangi receiver hai fir bhi ‘whom’ nahi ‘who’ ayega kyunki aage passive voice lagi hai or passive voice mein receiver subject hota hai.

questions.question: My shoes were worn out so I had to buy a new one.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘shoes’ plural mein likha jaane wala noun hai isliye iske 'ones' pronoun ka use hoga. a/an articles plural ke sath nahi aate aur yahan koi possession nahi banana isliye baki options galat hain.

questions.question: When I was working in a software company, it was mandatory to register my legally as an authorized software developer.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ‘to register’ infinitive mein aayi verb ke doer and receiver same hai isliye object ke roop mein ‘myself’ reflexive pronoun ka use hoga.

questions.question: Shailaja is prettier than either of her three cousins.
questions.solution: Explanation:-Shailaja ka comparison 3 cousins se karna hai isliye ‘either’ nhi ‘any’ ka use hoga. kyunki ‘either’ 2 ke liye aata hai. Note:- Prettier ki intensity badhane ke liye ‘most’ adverb ka use nahi ho sakta isliye 'a' option galat hai

questions.question: I am sorry of which my mother said.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Jab aap jis cheez ke liye maafi mangte ho toh uss case mein 'sorry for ' ka use hota hai. Eg. I am sorry for my bad behaviour. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki mai maffi chahunga jo meri maa ne kaha tha uske liye. yani yahan koi antecedent nahi hai isliye 'what' relative pronoun ka use hoga. Note:- 'what my mother said' ye pura noun clause 'for' preposition ka object banega.
